_comment: Provenance for the music bed. The project records where every price came from; a track that ships in 30 public videos deserves the same treatment.
source: Supplied by the project owner, who holds it as licensed.
note: The filename follows the Pixabay pattern (artist-title-numericid), and Pixabay's Content License permits commercial use without attribution. That is an inference from the filename, not a verified fact. Confirm the source before any video using this bed is made public.
level_note: Levelled for music-only video (mean about -17 dBFS). If narration is added later, re-cut at roughly -12dB so the voice sits on top — it is a one-line ffmpeg change.
